title: Supplement to 'Sharp bounds on the Eliashberg critical temperature': Lean formalization, computer-assisted certificates and scripts
description:
This supplement accompanies D. Rens, "Sharp bounds on the Eliashberg critical temperature: a comparison principle, convexity in the spectrum, and the Kiessling–Altshuler–Yuzbashyan conjectures".

Lean 4 formalizes the finite-dimensional core using Mathlib v4.35.0. The 16 theorems use only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. Two calculations certify the Einstein inequality and include their results: the primary proof uses Arb ball arithmetic, and the independent check uses exact rationals. The scripts also generate the certificate values quoted in the paper, the figure data and the floating-point checks. The paper identifies the floating-point values separately from the certified results.
